recognize_zh: 高倍下可見成群的大型多形性細胞，核呈多葉或腎形、染色質空泡狀、具明顯核仁，外觀類似何杰金/RS 細胞，但排列成片、沿血管周圍分布，並有凋亡細胞與纖維化背景，屬於灰區淋巴瘤的形態。
features: Large atypical cells with polylobated, folded or kidney-shaped vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli, resembling Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg and lacunar-like cells
Moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm, some with retraction clefts/clear halos
Cells arranged in cohesive-appearing clusters and sheets, partly around small blood vessels
Scattered apoptotic/pyknotic cells and small lymphocytes
Background of eosinophilic fibrinous/sclerotic stroma (lower left)
describe_en: High-power section shows clusters and sheets of large pleomorphic cells with polylobated or folded vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, including Hodgkin-like and lacunar-like forms, distributed around small vessels. Scattered apoptotic cells and small lymphocytes are present, and there is adjacent eosinophilic fibrinous/sclerotic stroma. The sheet-like growth of Hodgkin-like cells with a relatively sparse inflammatory background does not fit classic Hodgkin lymphoma or typical large B-cell lymphoma cleanly. In conjunction with the immunophenotype (CD20/Oct-2 retained, CD15 positive, CD30 limited), findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, syncytial variant of nodular sclerosis
ddx.vs: Syncytial cHL has sheets of HRS cells but they are strongly CD30+/CD15+ with loss of CD20 and Oct-2, and a mixed eosinophil-rich background.
PMBL cells are more monotonous with clear cytoplasm and fine compartmentalizing fibrosis, with strong uniform CD20 and absent CD15.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei growing in sinuses, uniformly strong CD30 and a T-cell/null phenotype without B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: Cohesive epithelial or germ cell tumors express keratin, SALL4 or OCT3/4 and lack CD45 and B-cell markers.
